items.evidence: "Remote control design kickoff" with "Original, trendy, user friendly".
Notes never describe the team roles (marketing looks at user needs, UI designer at usability, industrial designer at engineering/materials). Names appear only in action items.
"Three-phase design approach" / "Functional design first phase" matches the transcript (three phases, first is functional design).
"Electronic whiteboard introduction" / "Pen tool, erase, color, line width".
"Drawing demo of animals for creativity" plus dolphin, elephant, tiger, ant listed.
"Usability and inclusivity discussed" and "Material should be light".
Key says no action items. Notes list five; the PM did say he would put minutes in the project folder, but most others (e.g. UI designer to "Prepare intuitive design concepts") were not agreed.
"Intuitive design" is stated, but not the point about sticking to what people are familiar with / no revolutionary changes.
Key lists no problems; notes raise no major problem beyond minor whiteboard responsiveness and limited margin, both said in the transcript.

errors.why_wrong: The UI designer liked the dolphin for its freedom only; nothing about smooth design ("Sure looks smooth" was said about the tiger drawing).

errors.claim: Mark Knopp - Provide personal assignments to team members
errors.why_wrong: The PM said the personal coach will give the personal assignments, not him.

errors.claim: User Interface Designer - Prepare intuitive design concepts
errors.why_wrong: No one assigned or agreed to this task in the meeting.

errors.claim: Xavier Juukens - Address material considerations for lightweight design
errors.why_wrong: He only suggested the material should be light; no task was assigned.
